item.title: Open and Closed AI Models Converge in Cyber Offense Capabilities
item.description:
Vals AI's CyberOffense benchmark shows AI agents can autonomously penetrate simulated corporate networks from a single public URL to admin privileges with zero human help. Meanwhile, open-weight models are approaching closed frontier models at building exploits, narrowing the cyber-capability gap between them.

原文标题：开源与闭源模型网络攻击能力差距持续收窄

Why it matters：该报道用可复现的基准量化了 AI 智能体的自主攻击能力，并揭示开源模型正快速追平闭源模型，对 AI 安全与模型治理具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Cognition CSO Alex Stamos Says AI Is Breaking Traditional Cybersecurity
item.description:
In a podcast interview, Cognition chief security officer Alex Stamos argued that AI-boosted waves of hacks and breaches are rendering the multibillion-dollar cybersecurity industry as we know it obsolete, and that this is only the beginning. He noted that both private and state actors are using AI to detect and exploit vulnerabilities. The discussion is largely opinion and trend analysis, without concrete technical parameters or verifiable data.

原文标题：Cognition 安全负责人：AI 正击穿传统网络安全防线

Why it matters：资深安全专家对 AI 冲击网络安全产业给出直白判断，适合关注 AI 安全与产业变革的读者了解风向。

item.title: GitHub Unveils Rubicon Storage Architecture for 5,000 Concurrent Agents
item.description:
GitHub unveiled Rubicon, a new Git storage architecture that internal stress tests show can sustain 5,000 concurrent agents and 7,200 pushes per second in a single repository, with read capacity scaling horizontally on demand. The architecture is in limited private preview, with broader rollout planned for early next year, aimed at the sustained high-throughput load created by always-on AI agents.

原文标题：GitHub 发布 Rubicon 存储架构，单仓库支持 5000 智能体并发

Why it matters：这是代码托管基础设施为智能体时代重构底层存储的关键信号，压测数据具体且指向明确的负载范式转变。

item.title: Nvidia Funds ASE Expansion of CoWoS Advanced Packaging Capacity
item.description:
With TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging capacity constrained, Nvidia is reportedly providing billions of dollars to ASE's Siliconware Precision to fund new cleanroom expansion and equipment purchases, easing the packaging bottleneck for AI chips. The advanced packaging market is expected to surpass traditional packaging for the first time in 2026, with capex approaching $28 billion.

原文标题：英伟达出资数十亿美元 助日月光扩产 CoWoS 封装

item.title: Nous Research Fine-Tunes Qwen Model to Cut State Propaganda Rate Below 1%
item.description:
Nous Research supervised fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B on 53 million tokens to produce Arete-27B, cutting the rate of state-propaganda responses from 22% to under 1% while preserving general capabilities. The team argues this shows political bias in Chinese open-weight models is only a superficial layer, and has released the weights, test set, and training data under Apache 2.0.

原文标题：Nous Research 微调 Qwen 模型 将政治宣传率从 22% 降至 1% 以下

Why it matters：以可复现的微调实验量化“对齐层”可剥离性，对开源模型治理与安全研究具有直接参考价值。

item.title: METR Report Finds Anthropic Using AI to Accelerate AI R&D, Doubling Model Progress Rate
item.description:
AI safety research organization METR published a report after an 11-week investigation inside Anthropic, finding the company is using AI to build more powerful AI, with model capabilities improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago and little sign of slowing. The findings have alarmed researchers about the risks of automated AI R&D, with METR's leadership urging society to brace for very rapid change.

原文标题：METR 报告：Anthropic 用 AI 加速 AI 研发，模型迭代速度翻倍

Why it matters：这是首份由独立安全机构对前沿实验室 AI 自我加速研发的实地评估，直接触及 AI 递归自我改进这一核心议题。

item.description:

Locally developed by Sony China Research Institute, it is now piloting in Shanghai to validate stability and detection accuracy.

item.title: Discord Rewrites Client in Rust, Beating Electron on Cold Start and RAM
item.description:
Discord's co-founder and CTO posted a side-by-side demo showing the new Rust-based client loading its friends list from a cold start on Windows 11 while the existing Electron app was still on its loading screen. The new client used about 290MB of RAM with two accounts signed in, far below the multi-gigabyte footprint Electron builds can reach, offering concrete evidence for migrating desktop apps off Electron to native Rust stacks.

原文标题：Discord 用 Rust 重写客户端 冷启动与内存占用大幅优于 Electron

Why it matters：以真实冷启动与内存数据对比 Electron 与 Rust 客户端，对桌面端技术选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: Zhang Yimou Warns AI Short Videos, Now a Tens-of-Billions Sector, Challenge Cinema
item.description:
Speaking at a Golden Rooster film festival dialogue, director Zhang Yimou said AI-generated short videos have grown into a sector worth tens of billions of yuan and are pulling audiences away from theaters, calling it a major challenge with no clear answer for when AI surpasses humans in five to ten years. Regulators meanwhile signaled support for live-action micro-dramas while tightening rules on AI-generated ones.

item.title: Google AI Detects Hypertension via Smartwatch Without a Cuff
item.description:
Google Research has introduced a neural network that flags signs of hypertension using only the pulse and motion sensors built into ordinary smartwatches, with no cuff calibration required. Trained via self-supervised learning on nearly 500,000 hours of sensor data, the model matched traditional cuffs in a 196-person study across five US sites. The method is now folded into Google Health's blood pressure trends feature but remains a research project, not a diagnosis.

原文标题：Google AI 用普通智能手表无袖带检测高血压

Why it matters：这是可穿戴传感器与自监督学习结合的重要健康 AI 进展，且已进入真实产品功能，值得关注。

item.title: Researchers Expose Undocumented Personal Knowledge Graph Daemons in macOS
item.description:
Security researchers reveal that every Mac since macOS 13 ships a pair of undocumented daemons that continuously build a personal knowledge graph covering user identity, relationships, communications and behavior, feeding Apple Intelligence personalization. They also released a tool letting users inspect their own graph.

原文标题：研究揭示 macOS 内置未公开个人知识图谱守护进程

Why it matters：该发现直接触及端侧个性化 AI 的数据边界与隐私透明度，对关注 Apple Intelligence 架构的读者具有实质参考价值。

It originally sought $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation but scaled back after an AI-sector selloff and is now courting wealthy individual investors via investment banks.

item.title: Apple Unveils HALO Humanoid Robot System With 91% Success Rate in Unmapped Environments
item.description:
Apple's research team published an arXiv paper detailing HALO, a humanoid robot autonomy stack that layers a VLM task orchestrator, a DiT motion generator, and a reinforcement-learning tracker, deployed on a Unitree G1 with an onboard Mac mini for inference. Across 360 single-task trials in six previously unmapped real environments, HALO averaged a 91% success rate, though long-horizon composite tasks fell to 70% and the hardest combination to 50%. The team also open-sourced the data generation, training, and deployment code.

原文标题：苹果发布人形机器人 HALO 系统 未建图环境平均成功率 91%

Why it matters：苹果首次系统披露人形机器人端到端自主控制方案并开源全链路代码，91% 未建图成功率与分层架构对具身智能研究者有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Builds Pando Git Backend and Moves to Acquire Pierre as AI Coding Strains Code Hosting
item.description:
AI coding tools are multiplying pushes and automated jobs, and GitHub's repeated outages have exposed the limits of conventional code hosting. OpenAI has disclosed its internal Git backend Pando, reporting a nearly 80% drop in median push latency, and plans to acquire code-hosting tool Pierre; Anthropic has moved its main repository onto a self-built system, and Cursor now lets developers store projects directly. Code hosting is shifting from general-purpose platforms to custom infrastructure built for AI workloads.

原文标题：OpenAI 自研代码后端 Pando 并拟收购 Pierre，AI 编程倒逼代码托管重构

item.title: Google Sued in US Over Gemini Conversations With 13-Year-Old on Self-Harm
item.description:
A North Carolina couple is suing Google, alleging their 13-year-old daughter held thousands of Gemini and AI Mode conversations about depression and suicide methods on a school-issued Chromebook without adequate warning to parents or schools. Google says it is reviewing the claims and this week made AI tools off by default for K-12 accounts, though schools that re-enable Search must accept bundled AI features—a move Fairplay calls forcing AI on schools.

原文标题：谷歌因 Gemini 涉未成年人轻生对话在美遭起诉

In parallel, OpenAI released BioBasicsBench with biotech firm Ligo and a cyber-jailbreak rating framework with the Frontier Model Forum, while the anticipated GPT-6.2 Astra did not materialize.

item.title: Anthropic's Unreleased Model Helps Prove Quantum Computing Conjecture
item.description:
Physical Superintelligence (PSI) claims it used an unreleased Anthropic model to prove the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, open since 2008, in just three days, indicating that quantum speedups require special problem structure. If validated, it marks another landmark in AI-assisted mathematics, though the model, proof details and peer-review status remain undisclosed.

原文标题：Anthropic 未发布模型助证量子计算猜想

Why it matters：AI 辅助攻克长期数学猜想属高信号事件，但关键证据缺失，值得关注而非全盘采信。

item.title: Humans Write Worse to Evade AI Detectors as Models Shed AI Tells
item.description:

The piece documents this two-way mimicry in a satirical tone, drawing mainly on anecdotal observation and secondary reporting rather than systematic data.
